title: Multi-Factor Wealth Discovery Matrix
verified: NIFTY 500 core plus NSE cap-bucket overlays, price trend, sector-relative strength, revenue and earnings growth, profitability, leverage, valuation, liquidity, news catalysts and risk
source: Official NIFTY 500 core with top large, mid and small-cap discovery overlays, Yahoo market/fundamental feeds and outcome-learning history
refreshCycle: Technical and catalyst signals refresh intraday; fundamental factors are cached for six hours.
caveat: Research screening only—not a guarantee of returns. Verify exchange filings, valuation, governance, liquidity, and position sizing before investing.

rejectionSummary.reason: Earnings growth is not consistent across at least two of the last three years.
Sector-relative return is below the -5% regime floor.
Decision score is below the 72/100 regime-adjusted threshold.
Operating cash flow is below 70% of reported earnings.
Revenue growth is not consistent across at least two of the last three years.
Current price move is too extended for a fresh recommendation.
Latest annual revenue growth is below the 5% floor.
Decision score is below the 75/100 regime-adjusted threshold.
ROE is below the 8% quality floor.
Decision score is below the 70/100 regime-adjusted threshold.

methodology: Uniform benchmark-relative screening; no example stock receives a score adjustment or guaranteed inclusion.
Mandatory gates cover data freshness, positive TTM earnings, revenue direction, ROE, leverage, valuation, liquidity, trend, price extension and market regime.
News sentiment, government policy, sector direction, expert consensus and learning feedback are capped context adjustments; they cannot bypass a failed safety gate.

Each market-cap category returns exactly three ranked stocks when at least three were evaluated. Stocks that clear every gate are Accumulate ideas; deterministic backfills remain Watchlist ideas with their failed gates disclosed.
